# DubWorld

> DubWorld dubs a video into another language on your own computer: speech to text with word timestamps, translation, synthetic voice kept in step with the original video, subtitles and a new video. Turkish by default; other languages per voice engine. Windows 10/11, local, no telemetry; no model weights in the repository.

Rules that never change: licence and consent steps belong to the human (never accept for the user); every download is pinned by version/commit and sha256; no personal paths, e-mail addresses or tokens in anything you write (use `<ROOT>`).

## Start here
- [scripts/tani.ps1](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/scripts/tani.ps1): run this first; read-only report (system, GPU, disk, install profile, deviations from the defaults); keep your progress in `DURUM.md` (git-ignored notebook in the repo root)
- [AGENTS_HIZLI.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/AGENTS_HIZLI.md): 12-step decision tree and exit code to action table (English and Turkish)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/AGENTS.md): full install, hard rules, options and verification
- [README.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/README.md): overview and quick start (English is authoritative)

## When something fails
- [docs/hata_imzalari.json](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/docs/hata_imzalari.json): stable error codes with the first step in English and Turkish
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): the same list for people

## Safety, licence, privacy
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private reporting, what counts as a vulnerability
- [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): no telemetry; the only network addresses
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute
- [THIRD_PARTY.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/DubWorld/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY.md): licences of every model and tool
